reason: The patch adds the SQL rejection only in ReadQuery (pkg/expr/reader.go, QueryTypeSQL case), and nodes.go only calls that when FlagExpressionParser is on (nodes.go:123-140). On the default path, nodes.go:159-160 calls UnmarshalSQLCommand → NewSQLCommand → sql.TablesList, which now hits the stub DB and fails with a 'sql-invalid-sql' BadRequest (sql_command.go:30-35). That is a different error from the gate's "sqlExpressions is not implemented".
